# CmisConfigStatus5p4 — CMIS 5.4 Configuration Command Execution and Result Status (4-bit per-lane)

- Schema: `openxcvr.enum.v2` (kind `enum`), id `CmisConfigStatus5p4`
- Description: Configuration Command Execution and Result Status code set as printed by CMIS 5.4 Table 8-101 (p. 244). CmisConfigStatus keeps the pre-5.4 window, where code 8h is Reserved (other validation failures); CMIS 5.4 allocates 8h to ConfigRejectedNoEmulation, the DP Emulation rejection code added with the Network Path errata incorporation (CMIS 5.4 revision history M1/M2, § 7.6.9.3: a module that does not support DP Emulation of a nominal NP Application shall reject the DP configuration and report "preferably, ConfigRejectedNoEmulation" in ConfigStatusLane&lt;i&gt;). Revision-blind duplicate/overlap rules forbid re-covering the 8h-Bh span in place, so the since-5.4 code set lands here, following the CmisBanksSupported5p4 / CmisVdmObservableType5p4 precedent (ADV-01).
- Spec: `cmis` revision `5.4`
- Provenance: spec: CMIS 5.4 § 8.14.5 / Table 8-101 · pdf_pages: 244
- Revision applicability: revision-qualified — entry revision windows are interpreted within the known CMIS family domain (3.0, 4.0, 5.0, 5.1, 5.2, 5.3, 5.4); entries without a window apply throughout that domain only, never outside it
- Entry revision windows: `config_undefined` since `5.4` · `config_success` since `5.4` · `config_rejected` since `5.4` · `config_rejected_invalid_app_sel` since `5.4` · `config_rejected_invalid_data_path` since `5.4` · `config_rejected_invalid_si` since `5.4` · `config_rejected_lanes_in_use` since `5.4` · `config_rejected_partial_data_path` since `5.4` · `config_rejected_no_emulation` since `5.4` · `reserved_9_b` since `5.4` · `config_in_progress` since `5.4` · `custom_rejected` since `5.4`

| Value | Name | Aliases | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `config_undefined` | — | ConfigUndefined — no status information available (initial register value) |
